d:
A video from Bihar has gone viral showing Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary's security personnel stopping Health Minister Nishant Kumar from standing beside him. Nishant Kumar, son of former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, was pushed back by a security commando during an official visit to Vaishali. The incident triggered a political controversy, with JDU leaders demanding an explanation. However, Bihar's Special Security Group (SSG) later described it as a human error. What exactly happened?
